user.title: Set up a panel
user.description: Add a panel on your network, or install ha-paneld on one plugged into this computer.

menu_options.add_panel: Add a panel on your network
menu_options.install_usb: Install using USB on this computer

menu_option_descriptions.add_panel: Enter the panel's address. Home Assistant connects it if ha-paneld is running, or offers to install ha-paneld if it isn't.
menu_option_descriptions.install_usb: Plug the panel into this computer, not into the Home Assistant server.

install_usb.title: Install using USB
install_usb.description:
[Open the USB installer]({usb_install_url}). Plug the panel into the device running this browser, not into the Home Assistant server, and use a browser with WebUSB support with USB debugging enabled on the panel.

The installer puts ha-paneld on a panel that does not have it yet, then hands over to the panel's own setup. Come back here afterwards to add the panel to Home Assistant. Submit returns to the setup menu.

add_panel.title: Add a panel
add_panel.description: Pick a panel Home Assistant already knows through another app, or enter the panel's hostname or IP address. Panels marked ✓ already answer on network ADB. If ha-paneld isn't installed yet, first turn on network ADB on port 5555 using the [model-specific panel access guide]({panel_access_url}). Root access is not required. If the panel does not answer, [help for reaching a panel]({panel_help_url}) has steps for each model and other ways to install.

found_panel.title: ha-paneld is installed but not connected
found_panel.description: The ha-paneld app {version} is installed and set up at {address}, but it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet. Connect it to finish.

found_unconfigured.title: Finish setting up this panel
found_unconfigured.description: The ha-paneld app {version} is installed at {address}, but its setup isn't finished and it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet. Home Assistant can open the panel's setup wizard and connect the panel as soon as setup is done.

panel_setup.title: Finish the panel's setup
panel_setup.description: Complete the setup wizard in the window that opened. Home Assistant connects the panel as soon as its setup is done.

choose_version.title: Choose a version
choose_version.description: ha-paneld is not responding on {address}. Choose the version the panel should run. Test versions may contain bugs.

confirm_discovery.title: Confirm discovered panel
confirm_discovery.description: Home Assistant found a ha-paneld installation at {address}. Submit to verify it is still the same panel and add it as {panel_name}. No panel settings will change.

confirm_user.title: Confirm this panel's account
confirm_user.description: The panel {panel} is signed in to Home Assistant as {user} and is asking to connect. Confirming that account is all this panel still needs from you: it then finishes setting itself up on its own. Anyone signed in to Home Assistant can ask to connect as a panel, so confirm only if {user} is the account you set up for this panel. If you skip this, the panel is still added, but it stays unconnected until you confirm the account under Settings, then Repairs.

authorize_adb.title: Authorize Home Assistant on the panel
authorize_adb.description: The selected release includes a verified installation descriptor. Select Submit once to create or load a persistent ADB identity for this Home Assistant installation and offer its public key to the Android panel at {address}. On the panel, approve Android's Allow debugging prompt, then return here and select Submit again. Android may describe Home Assistant as a computer. Approval grants general ADB shell access while network debugging remains enabled; revoke it from the panel's developer settings. No APK is downloaded or installed at this step.

confirm_install_candidate.title: Confirm installation or recovery

confirm_install_rc.title: Confirm release candidate installation

release_preview_only.title: Release cannot be installed automatically
release_preview_only.description: Panel {address} is eligible for further inspection, and release {version} ({tag}, SHA-256 {sha256}) was authenticated. This release has no signed installation descriptor, so Home Assistant will not create an ADB credential, download the APK, or change the panel. Submit to choose another version.

install_result.title: Finish panel setup
install_result.description:
ha-paneld {version} was installed at {address}.

Submit to retry only the final read-only identity and health checks. No installation step will be repeated.

After Home Assistant adds the device, follow the browser setup link in the Add dialog on a computer that can reach the panel on its local network. If prompted, approve ADB on the panel.

progress.installing: Installing and verifying ha-paneld at {address}. Leave this dialog open to finish automatically. You may close it and Home Assistant will keep the installation job running, but it cannot add the device until you reopen Settings → Devices & services → Add integration, select Panel Assistant, choose Add a panel on your network and enter the same address. After Home Assistant adds the device, follow the browser setup link in the Add dialog on a computer that can reach the panel on its local network. If prompted, approve ADB on the panel.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid ha-paneld health endpoint.
error.invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme or path.
error.invalid_install_address: Enter only the panel hostname or IP address. The installer uses ha-paneld port 8888 and ADB port 5555 separately.
error.install_resolution_failed: Home Assistant could not resolve this panel address. Check the address and local DNS, then try again.
error.install_resolution_timeout: Local name resolution timed out before the panel address could be pinned safely. Check local DNS, then try again.
error.install_too_many_addresses: This hostname resolved to too many addresses to pin safely. Use a dedicated local hostname or private IP address.
error.unsafe_install_target: Installation is allowed only to a private local IPv4 address or a unique-local IPv6 address. No ADB connection was attempted.
error.install_target_changed: The hostname no longer resolves to the same pinned panel address. No ADB key or installation was sent. Check the address and start again.
error.adb_unreachable: The panel answered, but nothing answered on its Android Debug Bridge port (5555). On the panel, turn on Android Debug Bridge and allow it over the network, then try again. If you can plug the panel into the computer you are browsing on, install over USB instead.
error.panel_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the address is right and the panel is switched on and on your network, then try again. If you can plug the panel into the computer you are browsing on, install over USB instead.
error.adb_unauthorized: The panel still requires ADB authorization. Approve the prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_still_unauthorized: The panel has not accepted this Home Assistant instance yet. Approve the ADB prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_credential_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist its ADB credential. No panel change was attempted. Check the Home Assistant storage and logs before retrying.
error.installed_without_health: The ha-paneld package is installed but its health endpoint did not respond. This flow will not overwrite or repair it. Do not retry automatic installation; open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation. After restoring a healthy installation, start again to connect it.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain a retained ha-paneld package record or its package state could not be proven absent. No panel change was made. Retry once if the connection was unstable; otherwise follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation. Do not uninstall or reset the app without a verified backup.
error.incompatible: The ha-paneld package was not found, but the panel's Android SDK or processor architecture is not supported. No APK was downloaded or installed.
error.cannot_resolve_release: An install candidate was found, but Home Assistant could not resolve and verify the selected ha-paneld release. No APK was downloaded or installed. Check internet access and, if testing a release candidate, that the exact tag is published with its signed assets. No other release will be substituted.
error.invalid_release_candidate: Choose a version from the list.
error.install_candidate_changed: The panel identity or clean package state changed after the preview. No installation job was created. Start again after checking the panel.
error.installed_artifact_mismatch: The installed app is not byte-identical to the release you chose, so Home Assistant did not overwrite it; choose its exact release or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide.
error.install_plan_rejected: The panel and signed release could not be bound into a safe installation plan. No installation job was created.
error.install_job_conflict: A different installation job already owns this panel identity. No second job was created.
error.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist the installation receipt. No new panel action was authorized.
error.install_finalization_busy: Another setup dialog is completing this panel. Wait for it to finish, then retry if needed.
error.install_finalization_retry: The installation completed, but a final read-only network, ADB, or health check is temporarily unavailable. Check the panel and retry; the installation will not run again.
error.release_catalog_unavailable: Home Assistant couldn't load the list of versions. Check its internet access, then submit to try again.
error.release_catalog_empty: No versions are published yet. Submit to check again.
error.release_selection_required: Choose a version from the list.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered panel did not prove to be the same healthy ha-paneld installation. No Home Assistant entry or panel setting was changed.
abort.install_cancelled: The installation was cancelled before an APK was installed. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_cancelled_after_staging_cleanup: The installation was cancelled and the staged APK was removed before installation. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_authorization_failed: Home Assistant could not safely load or validate its stored ADB credential. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's storage and logs, then add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same address to try again.
abort.install_preflight_rejected: The panel no longer proved to be a clean, compatible installation target. No APK was installed. Correct the panel state described in the integration documentation before starting again with the same address.
abort.install_artifact_rejected: Home Assistant rejected the release download or staging operation before package installation. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's internet access, storage and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_transport_failed: Home Assistant could not complete the pre-install connection, download or staging step. No APK was installed. Check the panel, network, Home Assistant internet access and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_package_failed: Android definitively refused the APK and Home Assistant removed its staged file. No app or Home Assistant entry was created. Check the panel's compatibility and available storage before starting again.
abort.install_launch_failed: The APK is installed, but Home Assistant could not complete or verify the launch step. Do not retry automatic installation. Open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_health_check_failed: The APK is installed, but ha-paneld did not pass its health check. Do not retry automatic installation. Open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_ambiguous_mutation: An ADB staging, installation or launch operation may have changed the panel. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_verification_required: The panel changed, but Home Assistant could not verify the installed package or clean up its exact staged file. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_failed: The installer stopped with an unrecognized result. No Home Assistant entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation until you have checked the panel and the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_worker_stopped: The installer stopped and will not replay this job in the current Home Assistant process. Restart Home Assistant, reopen setup, and enter the same panel address to resume or receive a recovery result. No entry was created.
abort.install_recovery_required: Home Assistant cannot prove that it is safe to continue automatically. No entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app until you have followed the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely read the durable installation receipt. No entry was created.
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its pending panel state. Start setup again.

refused_hardened.message: The panel's Hardened mode does not allow this command

panel_user_mismatch.title: Confirm the Home Assistant user for {panel}

confirm_bind.title: Confirm the panel's user
confirm_bind.description: The panel {panel} asked to connect to Home Assistant as the user {user}. Confirm only if {user} is the account you set up for this panel. If you confirm, the panel should connect shortly afterwards. Anyone signed in to Home Assistant can ask to connect as a panel, so if you do not recognise this request, close this dialog and ignore the issue.

confirm_rebind.title: Change the panel's user
confirm_rebind.description: The panel {panel} is confirmed for the user {bound_user}, but the user {user} asked to connect as it. Confirm only if you changed this panel's account to {user}: the panel then stops accepting {bound_user} and should connect shortly afterwards. If you did not, someone else may be trying to take over the panel, so close this dialog and ignore the issue.

abort.entry_removed: This panel is no longer set up in Home Assistant.
abort.user_unavailable: The user who asked to connect no longer exists or is deactivated. Nothing was changed.

cutover_incomplete.title: Moving the entities of {panel} did not finish
cutover_incomplete.description: Panel Assistant could not finish moving the entities of {panel} between MQTT and itself: the {step} step failed with {error}. The panel keeps working, and the move carries on the next time the panel is reloaded or Home Assistant restarts. If it keeps failing, the Home Assistant log names the cause.

cutover_blocked_by_customised_entities.title: Customised MQTT entities hold back the MQTT withdrawal of {panel}
cutover_blocked_by_customised_entities.description: Panel Assistant now owns the entities of {panel}, but it has no equivalent for these MQTT entities, and they carry a name, icon, area, label, alias, or hidden or disabled setting of your own: {entities}. Delete them, or clear those settings, and the panel withdraws its MQTT entities the next time it connects. Until then it keeps announcing all of them.

native_controls_unavailable.title: Native controls unavailable on {panel}
native_controls_unavailable.description: Panel Assistant disabled these MQTT controls because {panel} has not offered their native actions: {entities}. Their configuration and entity IDs are preserved. Update the panel app and check that its action prerequisites are available, then reconnect it. Reboot also requires root access under MQTT. If a control worked over MQTT before, switching this panel back to MQTT temporarily restores it.

merged_panel_identity.title: Separate the merged panels: {panels}
merged_panel_identity.description: The panels {panels} report the same device identity, so Home Assistant cannot safely decide which entry owns a native connection or entity. Their native connection is refused and no entities are moved. Update ha-paneld on every affected panel so each has a distinct identity, then delete the merged device and let the panels register again.

merged_mqtt_device.title: Separate the merged MQTT device for {panel}
merged_mqtt_device.description: The MQTT device used by {panel} also carries the panel identifiers {panel_ids}. Panel Assistant keeps each panel's entities untouched, but Home Assistant cannot split a device after identifiers have been merged. Update ha-paneld on every affected panel, delete the merged device, then let the panels register again.

panel_update_required.title: Update ha-paneld on {panel}
panel_update_required.description: Panel Assistant now owns the entities of {panel}, but the version of ha-paneld on that panel still announces them over MQTT, so MQTT creates them a second time. Panel Assistant disables those duplicates. Update ha-paneld on {panel} to version {required_version} or later; Panel Assistant itself needs no update. Once the updated panel connects, the disabled duplicates are deleted and this issue goes away.

panel_migration_incomplete.title: The panel at {address} has not finished moving to its new app

confirm_migration.title: Check the panel again
confirm_migration.description: Panel Assistant installed version {version} on the panel at {address}, and the panel moves its settings to the new app by itself. That move had not finished when Home Assistant stopped waiting. The panel keeps working throughout and carries on where it left off, so nothing here changes it. Select Submit to look again.

abort.migration_unfinished: The new app has not answered yet. The panel carries on by itself, so open this issue again in a few minutes.

panel_address_unreachable.title: Home Assistant cannot reach {panel} at its stored address
panel_address_unreachable.description: {panel} is connected to Home Assistant, so its entities stay available, but Home Assistant cannot read the panel at {address}, and the connection it holds, from {session_address}, offers no other address to try. The panel's web port may be blocked between Home Assistant and the panel. If the panel has moved, add it again at its new address, which updates the stored address; the issue clears by itself once the address answers again.

panel_address_unverified.title: {panel} has moved, and its new address could not be confirmed
panel_address_unverified.description: {panel} is connected to Home Assistant from {session_address}, so its entities stay available, but Home Assistant cannot read the panel at its stored address {address}, and a check at {session_address} did not answer as this panel, so the stored address was not changed. If the panel has moved, add it again at its new address, which updates the stored address; the issue clears by itself once the stored address answers.

panel_identity_mismatch.title: Check the address for {panel}
panel_identity_mismatch.description: {address} did not answer as {panel}, so its controls have been paused. Check that this address belongs to the panel. If the panel moved, add it again using its current address.

panel_identity_confirmation.title: Keep this panel’s existing setup
panel_identity_confirmation.description: {panel} at {address} needs confirmation after an app update. Confirm that this is the panel whose existing setup you want to keep.

confirm_identity.title: Keep this panel’s existing setup
confirm_identity.description: Keep the existing entities and settings for {panel} at {address}?

abort.identity_changed: The panel changed while this confirmation was open. Open the latest repair and try again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the panel. Check its connection and try again.

init.title: Panel setup
init.description: Continue this panel’s setup, change its transport, or authorize ADB for panel updates. If the panel is still unbound, confirm its signed-in account to finish setup.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up this panel
onboarding.description: Open the panel's setup page from a browser that can reach the panel on your local network. Sign in with the Home Assistant account currently in that browser, choose the home dashboard, and finish setup there. Keep this dialog open; it will return here to confirm the account. If this browser cannot reach the panel, finish later from the panel's local network. Android debugging approval, if requested, still needs a person at the panel.

onboarding_wait.title: Waiting for the panel to connect
onboarding_wait.description: The panel has not yet finished setup or asked to connect as an account. Complete its setup page, then submit here to check again. The panel remains unbound until you confirm its account.

onboarding_confirm.title: Confirm this panel's account
onboarding_confirm.description: {panel} has signed in as {user} and asked to connect. Confirm only if this is the account you chose for this panel. Skipping leaves it unbound; you can confirm later in Repairs.

authorize_adb.title: Authorize Home Assistant on {panel}
authorize_adb.description: Select Submit to create or load this Home Assistant installation’s persistent ADB key and offer its public key to {panel}. Approve Android’s Allow debugging prompt on the physical panel, then submit again. Android may describe Home Assistant as a computer. Approval grants general ADB shell access while network debugging remains enabled; revoke it in the panel’s developer settings. No app is installed at this step.

transport.title: Panel transport
transport.description: Choose what controls this panel's entities and commands. Saving Panel Assistant moves the panel's MQTT entities to Panel Assistant, keeping their entity IDs, history and customisations, and the panel then withdraws its MQTT entities. Saving MQTT, with or without native reports, moves them back to MQTT. Either way the panel reconnects with the new choice.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid ha-paneld health endpoint.
error.invalid_install_address: Enter only the panel hostname or IP address. The installer uses ha-paneld port 8888 and ADB port 5555 separately.
error.install_resolution_failed: Home Assistant could not resolve this panel address. Check the address and local DNS, then try again.
error.install_resolution_timeout: Local name resolution timed out before the panel address could be pinned safely. Check local DNS, then try again.
error.install_too_many_addresses: This hostname resolved to too many addresses to pin safely. Use a dedicated local hostname or private IP address.
error.unsafe_install_target: Installation is allowed only to a private local IPv4 address or a unique-local IPv6 address. No ADB connection was attempted.
error.install_target_changed: The hostname no longer resolves to the same pinned panel address. No ADB key or installation was sent. Check the address and start again.
error.adb_unreachable: The panel answered, but nothing answered on its Android Debug Bridge port (5555). On the panel, turn on Android Debug Bridge and allow it over the network, then try again. If you can plug the panel into the computer you are browsing on, install over USB instead.
error.adb_still_unauthorized: The panel has not accepted this Home Assistant instance yet. Approve the ADB prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_credential_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist its ADB credential. No panel change was attempted. Check the Home Assistant storage and logs before retrying.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain a retained ha-paneld package record or its package state could not be proven absent. No panel change was made. Retry once if the connection was unstable; otherwise follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation. Do not uninstall or reset the app without a verified backup.
error.panel_identity_changed: The address no longer answers as this configured panel. Check the panel and its address before retrying.

abort.native_entities_disabled: Native entities are not turned on for this Home Assistant, so MQTT controls this panel.
